responsibility: Provides the combined pipeline scheduling description for the 604/604e/620/630 generation of rs6000 processors. It defines shared and CPU-specific execution units, plus differing latencies for integer, load/store, CR, branch, and floating-point operations across 32-bit 604-family and 64-bit 620/630 variants, so the RTL scheduler can distinguish these related but not identical 6xx microarchitectures.
